## TSMC widens foundry market lead in AI boom as Samsung trails at 7% share

Samsung's reported 7% foundry share versus TSMC's dominant position means AI silicon at advanced nodes is effectively a TSMC-captured market; this reinforces the TSMC moat thesis and raises strategic questions about Samsung's foundry relevance alongside its separate HBM challenges.

- TSMC is widening its lead in the AI-driven foundry market, per a Chosunbiz report.
- Samsung's foundry market share is reported at 7%, a significantly lagging position.
- The AI demand surge is explicitly cited as the driver of TSMC's relative competitive advantage.
- Single Korean outlet sourcing; no additional corroboration in this batch.
